items.title: Failure Modes & Recovery in LLM Tool-Calling Pipelines
items.abstract: MSc research investigating how large language model tool-calling pipelines fail in practice, and designing detection and recovery strategies to make agentic systems more reliable.
items.futureWork: Extending the failure taxonomy to long-horizon tasks and evaluating automated self-correction loops.

items.title: 3D-CNN Facial Recognition for Smart Access Control
items.abstract: A 3D Convolutional Neural Network for authenticating registered users to unlock doors, developed as the smart-door module of an AI home automation system.
items.futureWork: Improving robustness under low-light and spoofing conditions, and on-device inference.
